content.comment_body: Hello [user_name], I have a [article_no] [product_name]. I've set passwords for [product_name] software and web access, but I forgot them. I checked several forums but couldn't find a solution—I can't switch the device to STOP mode through the display menu. My firmware is [version_no]. The menu doesn't let me change to ADMIN mode since I don't know the correct password, despite trying common defaults like admin and logo. Is there a way to reset the device without the password, or do I need to buy a new one? Regards, [user_name]
Hi [user_name], If you've forgotten the passwords, unfortunately, there seems to be no way to access the device. You might want to submit a support request—perhaps [company_name] support can assist.
Hello [user_name], I'm disappointed about this situation. My concern isn't the program itself; I just hope I won't have to buy a new unit. Thank you for your help.

You could try using [product_name] software: go to Tools, then Transfer, and select Factory Reset. If you're unsure about the device's IP, use the blue icon in the interface dialog. Regards, [user_name]
This factory reset method works if a password hasn't been set for [product_name] access. However, if the password was set and forgotten, it won't help.

I've had a similar experience—locked myself out after setting a password. Luckily, I remember my password and can factory reset. Otherwise, using a blank program via SD card (saving an empty program file) doesn't resolve the lockout either.

Here's a method I've tested: Open [product_name] software, go to File -> Properties -> Online Settings. Connect to the device, then select Clear Program and Password in the left menu, and click Clear. Once the device is cleared, you can download a new program.

If you've set both the access and admin passwords and they've been forgotten, unfortunately, the device can't be factory reset unless it's in admin mode: 1) Display Method: Without the admin password, you can't place the device into admin mode from operator mode using the display. Only in admin mode can you set the device to STOP, which reveals the Factory Reset menu. 2) Software Method: Without the access password, you can't connect to the device software to execute a factory reset. Alternatively, you can try transferring an empty program onto a memory card and restarting the device with it inserted. This will put the device in STOP mode, but the Factory Reset option won't appear without the operator password. Summary: Factory reset isn't possible when both passwords are set and not known.

analysis.insight_summary: When users forget both access and admin passwords on [product_name], they become fully locked out, unable to reset or recover the device. There is confusion about potential recovery options, but no straightforward solution is available, causing frustration and raising concerns about needing to purchase new hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to be able to restore access and reset their [product_name] hardware even if passwords have been lost, aiming to avoid device replacement and maintain usability.
